properties.description: Classic Salesforce org holding the Forecast__c custom object (monthly subject). Uses the Salesforce Service Cloud V2 connector: type SalesforceServiceCloudV2 with OAuth2ClientCredentials, since V1 (username/password/security token) is at removal stage. environmentUrl is the org's My Domain URL, not login.salesforce.com. Requires a Connected App with client-credentials flow and an execution user holding the 'API Only' permission. This connector reads CRM objects over SOQL/Bulk API 2.0 and cannot read Data Cloud DLOs — the 60-month history is landed directly as Parquet instead. Set real values via ADF Studio UI or Key Vault.
